answer: Each new agent must lock a 100-token stake before trading; a sybil minting 10,000 shifting dune identities must freeze 1,000,000 tokens, so bulk fake agents cost more than any honest revenue. Reputation grows per bonded identity like a terrace cut into a hillside — slow to climb, expensive to replicate. Duplicated agents caught by peer attestation forfeit their bonds, leaving an oasis where only capital-backed identities survive.
